comment: Hand-encoded per-NIM storage/topology blockers and new-node historical notes for the ten ARCHVTEAMS-2407 BioNeMo NIM lanes, ordered evidence-first (Boltz2 and OpenFold2 carry the fresh fail-closed n=20 cohorts). Cohort statuses, outcomes, and further-required work are NOT encoded here: the builder derives them from the vendored catalog's measured evidence class and verifies every evidence ref against committed bytes (SHA-256 bound, sample counts re-counted, nearest-rank percentiles recomputed, digests and response-timing contract matched, zero current-contract new-node samples proven from the committed audit). New-preemptible-node cohorts do not exist under the current exact contract for any NIM, so they are recorded as required, never invented.
new_preemptible_required_default: fail-closed new-node cohort with at least 20 accepted samples per scenario (the authoritative n>=20 cohort aggregator) on a fresh preemptible GPU node under the current exact contract: setup_demand_at (scale dispatch) and demand_at (target submission) through call_2_response_received_at, never aliased or summed from independently aggregated phases; cold-node image qualification proving the image absent at scale T0 with the pulled exact digest bound afterward; exact clock, image-pull, and volume detach/attach receipts; prewarm receipts with named storage state; strict semantic validation; every accepted and failed attempt retained in a fail-closed ledger with nearest-rank p50/p95/max and the full failure denominator; no pooling of historical runs; exact-ID cleanup; newnode-v2 execution path only, via an approved resource-broker preemptible lease and the shared request-SLO harness
